scope: T independent source validation after candidate freeze

role_targets: aim for coverage; never force three questions if evidence is ambiguous
pressure_definition: processed pair count and evidence age relative to actual recent8 span, not clip duration alone
blind_admission: annotator sees original question and pixels, no candidate or reference answers

necessity_controls: separately label old-evidence removal/controlled replacement diagnostics, never treat author intervals as necessity proof
reporting: all supported admitted questions, including full-reference failures
download_authorization: separate concrete origin/bytes/time budget before any new acquisition
stop: one source-qualification pass with ambiguities preserved; report real eligible count and deficits instead of lowering criteria
